title: Greenwich Knight Armor
description: Replaces the diamond armor texture with 16x16 Greenwich knight armor
body:
Change's minecrafts diamond armor texture to a mid 1500's realistic (as possible) **16x16** Greenwich knight armor texture.

![player wearing the armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66086d4f976207b16d008bb3b87e6d23b455648e.png)
